items.description: Map the repository modules, helper scripts, and artifact dependencies before research execution
items.notes: Mapped repo modules and data flow in results/research_context.md; recorded missing TASK_orchestrator.md, empty verification start state, repaired concept_evolve evolve() launcher mismatch, and documented the first mandatory evolve attempt drifting without artifact output.

items.description: Freeze the active research problem from the saved swarm state before any implementation
items.notes: Froze H1 as champion, H2 as backup, and H3 as reserve in results/research_context.md using results/swarm/hypotheses.json and results/swarm/tool_plan.md; copied exact first experiment, global budgets, H1 budget envelope, and lane kill rules into the working plan.

items.description: Repair the off-target literature snapshot with a targeted web and Semantic Scholar pass
items.notes: Extended results/literature/literature_snapshot.json with a focused H1 lane section preserving the seed snapshot, logging targeted web queries and Semantic Scholar traversals, resolving fuzzy anchor titles, and curating directly relevant startup and multi-input harvesting papers.

items.description: Create and maintain the repository bibliography as a first-class research artifact
items.notes: Created sources.bib with focused H1 paper entries and validated DOI-or-URL coverage for the current set.

items.description: Build and maintain the prior-art differentiation matrix and explicit watchlist novelty check
items.notes: Filled dated differentiation notes for the false-neighbor watchlist papers and added the closest real H1 overlap papers with why-close, differentiation hypothesis, evidence artifacts, and pivot guidance.

items.description: Run a multi-agent literature and concept-tree scout pass and synthesize it into a champion concept set
items.notes: Produced the canonical six-folder H1 concept tree with index, adjacency, walk paths, tooling blocker notes, and an integrator memo selecting the top three concept folders.

items.description: Gate the execution environment and unblock required research tooling before baseline work
items.notes: Established a reproducible user-space ngspice path via tools/setup_ngspice_local.sh and tools/ngspice-local and documented current concept_evolve helper reliability status.

items.description: Define the champion concept folder structure, baseline interfaces, and dependency map
items.notes: Bound the H1 implementation to results/concept_evolve/tree/001_packet_scout_handoff_root and linked later artifacts back to this root.

items.description: Specify the source model, measurement hooks, and success metrics for weak multi-source cold start
items.notes: Froze the source matrix, mixed-polarity contract, and metric definitions in experiment_spec.md.

items.description: Implement and parameterize two strong baseline startup paths with equal accounting
items.notes: Implemented the fixed and nonaware baseline netlists with shared measurement hooks and no hidden helper rail.

items.description: Use multi-agent benchmark design review before running the core concept
items.notes: Closed the baseline benchmark review in verification/item011_signoff.md with guardrails against weak comparisons.

items.description: Generate and rank source-adaptive cold-start architecture variants inside the concept tree
items.notes: Materialized three H1 variants under the packet-scout subtree with short READMEs, dependency lists, and predicted failure modes.

items.description: Implement the champion topology family and one ablation family in modular netlist form
items.notes: Implemented the preferred champion deck plus the source-awareness-removed ablation with shared behavior factored into the shared includes.

items.description: Run an explicit novelty screen against named prior work before claiming a contribution
items.notes: Added the H1 claim matrix and downgraded unsupported startup-voltage, PMU-breadth, and efficiency claims.

items.description: Iterate the concept tree using research feedback rather than ad hoc local changes
items.notes: Ran the mandatory concept_evolve iterate command and updated bridge_candidates.json, concept_delta.json, and recurrent_state.json.

items.description: Use multi-agent core research synthesis to select one champion and one kill-ready fallback
items.notes: Recorded a parent synthesis memo that kept exactly one active H1 champion, one kill-ready fallback, and retired the weaker branches.

items.description: Execute the champion go-kill startup matrix in ngspice within the stated budget
items.notes: Verified the 24-case startup matrix and rebuilt the startup manifests and summary tables from the raw artifacts.

items.description: Benchmark the champion against the two baselines with equal overhead accounting
items.notes: Built the literature-mapped benchmark table and documented that the primary matrix showed no startup-success gain for the ranked champion.

items.description: Stress the claim with adversarial source conditions and blocker-triggered fallback checks
items.notes: Executed the falsifier suite, exposed nonaware back-drive and startup failures, and narrowed rather than killed H1.

items.description: Use multi-agent monitoring and audit during experiment execution
items.notes: Audited the startup and falsifier run logs and froze the broad sweep until the H1 lane decision memo.

items.description: Make a lane promotion or kill decision from evidence, not intuition
items.notes: Kept H1 alive only as a narrowed adversarial startup-correctness claim and rejected broader win stories.

items.description: Analyze mechanism, sensitivity, and boundary conditions of the winning concept
items.notes: Generated the H1 sensitivity package and identified the small surviving claim boundary.

items.description: Complete the bibliography and source-to-claim audit
items.notes: Extended sources.bib and created the citation audit that blocks unsupported novelty wording.

items.description: Produce a novelty-market verification artifact pack under results/verification
items.notes: Created the repo-level verification pack and blocked broad H1 performance or priority claims.

items.description: Use multi-agent writing and review to bound the claim and final narrative
items.notes: Created the final research brief with validated claims, the closest prior work, and explicit kill conditions that remain open.

items.description: Finalize the reproducibility bundle in the champion concept folder and repo root
items.notes: Updated the champion-root README and repo-level context so another researcher can restart from the narrowed H1 endpoint.

items.description: Restore rubric discipline, freeze the DEEPEN lane, and probe the biggest open novelty question
items.acceptance_criteria: Recreate `research_rubric.json` as a valid ledger with the pre-DEEPEN phases preserved plus a new `Novelty Deepening` phase, set the active lane to `H1_confidence_gated_abstention`, run `python3 .archivara/concept_evolve.py probe "Can a low-energy confidence metric outperform blind packet gating on near-tie weak-source startup cases without hidden helper behavior?"`, and update `results/research_context.md` plus `results/concept_evolve/concept_delta.md` with the lane freeze, probe result, and current kill rule.
items.notes: Restored research_rubric.json with the pre-DEEPEN phases plus phase_6, froze H1_confidence_gated_abstention in results/research_context.md, ran the mandatory concept_evolve probe command on the exact near-tie confidence question, and recorded the degraded probe result plus kill rule in results/concept_evolve/concept_delta.md.

items.description: Repair the metric/control package needed for causal novelty claims
items.acceptance_criteria: Update the H1 shared measurement hooks and experiment notes so `startup_ok`, handoff, fall, and second-rise are tied to explicit `n_handoff` events rather than only `V(n_store)` proxies, and repair or replace the same-scaffold no-packet control so it uses equal accounting and can run under the shared tooling.
items.notes: Replaced the broken switch-based handoff flag with a hysteretic behavioral latch, switched measurement_hooks.inc to explicit n_handoff event timing while preserving store-threshold diagnostics, rebuilt blind_packet_merge on the shared packet_scout_blocks scaffold with VCTRL_MON accounting, extended the shared runners to include the no-packet control, and verified the repair with startup/falsifier smoke tests recorded in verification/item028_metric_control_repair.md.

items.description: Implement the confidence-gated abstention startup variant on the existing packet scaffold
items.acceptance_criteria: Add one new helper-free `ngspice` deck on the packet-gated scaffold that computes a low-energy separability or confidence metric, abstains to the blind packet path while evidence is ambiguous, commits only after a confidence threshold clears, runs `python3 .archivara/concept_evolve.py reframe "Do electrical engineering research and discover something new/interesting. nontrivial and important. maybe you design a new circuit and use ng spice or something"`, and records the design rationale and novelty delta in `results/concept_evolve/concept_delta.md`.
items.notes: Added the helper-free confidence_gated_abstention deck plus variant README under the packet_scout_handoff subtree, extended packet_scout_blocks.inc with a normalized separability integrator that defaults to blind packet isolation until n_commit rises, ran the mandatory concept_evolve reframe command (which again produced no useful framings), updated results/concept_evolve/concept_delta.md with the design rationale and novelty delta, and recorded smoke tests in verification/item029_confidence_variant.md showing early commit on a late-arrival separator case and no commit on a near-tie case.

items.description: Execute the near-tie DEEPEN experiment matrix and apply the kill rule
items.acceptance_criteria: Run a near-tie matrix of no more than 16 cases comparing `source_blind`, `time_constant_ranked`, and the new confidence-gated variant, plus the repaired same-scaffold no-packet control on decisive separator cases; use unequal `VOC`, `1:1` to `1:3` impedance spread, and unequal or late-arrival ramps; store raw artifacts under the H1 concept root and produce summary tables/figures covering `startup_ok`, explicit handoff events, `e_ctrl`, `e_backdrive`, and abstain-to-commit transitions; record whether the new lane survives or is killed.
items.notes: Executed the bounded 12-case DEEPEN near-tie matrix plus 4 same-scaffold blind_packet_merge control runs with tools/run_h1_deepen.py, wrote raw artifacts/tables/runlog under the H1 root, generated figures/h1_deepen_confidence_tradeoff.svg, and recorded the decision in verification/item030_deepen_matrix.md: confidence gating survives only as a temporal-separability controller that beats source_blind on late-arrival cases, collapses to the blind posture on static near ties, and remains slower than time_constant_ranked.

items.description: Close the novelty loop with a targeted overlap screen and verification refresh
items.acceptance_criteria: Before final signoff, run a targeted `Semantic Scholar` pass focused on abstention-like pre-handoff controls or near-tie source-selection overlap, update `sources.bib`, `results/literature/prior_art_gap.md`, and the H1 claim boundary notes, refresh the DEEPEN verification artifacts, run `python3 .archivara/concept_evolve.py iterate "Do electrical engineering research and discover something new/interesting. nontrivial and important. maybe you design a new circuit and use ng spice or something"`, update `results/concept_evolve/concept_delta.md`, and leave no phase-6 item in `pending` or `in_progress`.
